entries.0186d8888af0d7e6: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥7,338 million, a decrease of 21.8% from the previous year. The company states that revenue from its main PC Curtain Wall Business declined, as development projects were repeatedly postponed or revised due to estimates reflecting rising material costs and labor shortages, and as the amount of construction that general contractors can handle decreased due to work-style reform. On the other hand, the company states that revenue in the Aqua Business increased, due to new school pools, a rise in hotel pools driven by inbound demand, and growing demand for maintenance and renovation of existing pools.

entries.76b0c7ab37672d1c: As its medium-term management strategy, the company says it will continue to strengthen personnel in the PC Curtain Wall Business and respond to requests from architectural design firms and general contractors for design and improvements in environmental performance, such as decarbonization. In the pool business as well, it says it will strengthen personnel and put in place a structure able to meet demand for new construction and maintenance over the long term. Among the issues it has to address, it cites capturing growing demand for stainless steel pools, taking over maintenance work from companies that withdraw, and expanding the Aqua Business by entering adjacent fields.
